file_and_mcu_objects.source_object: /data/openpilot and the exact launcher-selected program tree
file_and_mcu_objects.known_coverage: 17 selected path hashes in software; historical SP2027 full-file manifest; neither is a new full current archive
file_and_mcu_objects.sensitivity: May contain user data; review inventory and exclusions before content copying.
acceptance: Resolve active path/symlinks without importing code; record dependencies and executable hashes.
Retain mode/owner/symlinks/xattrs needed for restore, and verify extraction on a private local copy.
Changed files stay in a failed/partial capture set; encrypted code remains opaque.

file_and_mcu_objects.source_object: OS package/dependency inventory, selected launch/supervisor configuration and overlays
file_and_mcu_objects.known_coverage: Current fstab/ab_mount/libabctl hashes and selected app files; migration reports note post-boot expansion/dependency changes
file_and_mcu_objects.sensitivity: Do not collect environment/credentials or broad configuration by default.
acceptance: Record selected package/library/build versions and owner/launch graph without running target app code.
Store only approved nonprivate contents or summaries; exact restored versions and restart impact remain explicit.

file_and_mcu_objects.source_object: Application parameters/calibration and other mutable /data or /systemrw state
file_and_mcu_objects.known_coverage: Historical 7503-member software archive and 182 selected configurations; not full userdata, not atomic
file_and_mcu_objects.sensitivity: Raw values, keys and identity stay in approved private storage; this plan does not read them.
acceptance: Define object allowlist and confidentiality/retention before capture.
Separate necessary state from reconstructible cache and optional recordings; list each exclusion and recovery impact.
Two equal manifests are insufficient proof of an atomic cross-file snapshot.

file_and_mcu_objects.source_object: Host keys/provisioning and hardware-unique data in shared partitions
file_and_mcu_objects.known_coverage: Some host partitions preserved historically; current equivalence and MCU coverage unknown
file_and_mcu_objects.sensitivity: Explicit private preservation plan; no key contents, serial plaintext or provisioning copied to the repository.
acceptance: Determine supported preservation/restore semantics before any erase/write; never assume OTP writable or readable.
Keep per-unit state separate from redistributable software and prevent replacement by factory defaults.

file_and_mcu_objects.known_coverage: USB DOS descriptor and selected disk firmware artifacts only
acceptance: Do not equate disk bin/version, DOS/F4 classification or a USB serial hash with live MCU identity.
Collect only audited requests after separately defined active-session conditions; unknowns do not block host-only backup.
Per-board recovery support and device-specific state preservation are independent of host UFS backup.

file_and_mcu_objects.known_coverage: No external-board inventory in the retained session
acceptance: Do not connect to a running unknown supervisor as an enumeration shortcut.
Each board has its own identity/recovery record; incomplete group stays UNBOUND.

limitations: Partition numbers/names and historical archive containment are lookup evidence, not executable restore targets.
Whole-LUN archives include GPT, gaps and device-unique areas; do not automatically write them back.
Current capture hashes are null; no current block, application or private-state capture is produced by this document.
Raw GUIDs and private contents are not copied into this matrix.

consistency_classes.meaning: Bounded state observations and source references; no recoverable content snapshot.
Running file/block reads with per-object drift checks; not atomic or application-consistent across objects.
Specified range repeatedly matches and pre/post mapping/mounts are consistent; evidence of observed stability only, not proof that all writes were excluded.
A documented, verified application-consistency method covers the relevant file set; service stop alone is insufficient.
A separately scoped environment prevents source writers for the documented object set; mount/boot/MCU dependencies still need mapping.

capture_manifest_contract.partial_capture_policy: Keep failed/partial objects and their reason; never merge across capture_set IDs without an explicit compatibility comparison.
capture_manifest_contract.copy_policy: Raw images/configuration stay in existing private storage outside the repository; record only sanitized metadata and hashes.
capture_manifest_contract.resumption_policy: Revalidate identity, range and source generation before resuming; an offset checkpoint alone is insufficient.

offline_allowed: Model restore operations on synthetic GPT tables or copied small metadata; do not modify original archives.
Check bounds, primary/backup CRC consistency, A/B type and attribute handling, and unchanged non-target bytes for each candidate.
Resolve duplicate DSP labels through documented boot/mount evidence; same UUID does not imply same full contents.

stages.name: Freeze sources and validate bounded evidence
actions: Verify source files and retain original timestamps; calculate coverage from existing GPT metadata.
acceptance: Every factual reference has a path/hash; historical reports are not new device observations.
stop_conditions: Source missing or hash mismatch: mark only dependent conclusions unavailable; preserve all originals.

stages.name: Plan current capture set and gather passive metadata
actions: Assign capture_set_id; inspect current layout/mounts/free capacity/software digests/service relationships with reviewed passive collectors.
Choose explicit object ranges, byte/time budgets, private destinations and preservation/exclusion policy.
acceptance: Object matrix and privacy boundary are concrete; unknown content hashes remain null.
No Panda ownership, recovery-mode entry or restore rehearsal prerequisite for ordinary host file/metadata backup.
stop_conditions: Mapping/identity drift, unsupported safe-read primitive, collection cap, permission gap, unexpected device node or secret path: stop that object without fallback.

stages.name: Capture and verify host materials incrementally
actions: Capture approved ordinary files and block ranges to private host storage in bounded resumable objects.
Hash actual read stream and archive, record start/end stat/mount/layout and source stability; use offline decompression verification when an archive exists.
Label running mutable-state copies BEST_EFFORT; retain exclusions instead of claiming whole-device consistency.
acceptance: Each object passes length/hash/metadata checks independently; present objects can pass while others remain unknown.
Host material completeness does not depend on Panda identity, exclusive native I/O, a recovery port or a completed restore test.
Any stronger consistency claim names the verified mechanism and its cross-object scope.
stop_conditions: Insufficient destination capacity, read failure, unstable source, mismatched range/hash or sensitive content beyond allowlist.
Do not freeze/unmount/stop services/reboot to improve consistency without a separately defined operation scope.

stages.name: Design restore recipe and isolation exit plan
actions: Compare original GPT and offline candidate behavior; plan unambiguous DSP selection.
Prepare per-operation impact, backup dependency, timeout, exit and recovery escalation tables for the actual service/supervisor graph.
Document physical port/power/line isolation and tool/loader evidence gaps; use local archive copies or synthetic fixtures for restore logic.
acceptance: Recipes name exact objects and targets; no original anomaly overwritten, no live commands executed.
Identify which future actions need merely an app exit path versus an independent boot/MCU recovery path.
stop_conditions: Unknown automatic writes/reset/flash behavior, ambiguous DSP/GPT mapping, unbounded cleanup or unavailable safe exit leaves that action unexecutable.

stages.name: Perform separately scoped stateful preparation if needed
actions: Only if explicitly scoped later: stop/return identified services, use a verified consistency environment, identify recovery mode or obtain exclusive board sessions.
Validate return to the baseline after each step; never combine entry recognition with writing a recovery image.
acceptance: Required backup subset for the specific action is verified; exact operator/sequence/limits/return actions recorded.
Do not require a successful whole-device destructive restore before a reversible service-isolation step; require proportionate, credible exit safeguards.
Any unexpected firmware/bootloader write behavior stops the operation before native probing.
stop_conditions: Unidentified supervisor/accessor, lost agreed exit path, changed board identity, unplanned USB role/reset/flash or operation outside the concrete scope.

stages.name: Qualify restore ability and hand off to noOutput bench
actions: First validate restore range selection and extraction on private copies/replaceable media.
Any real writeback/slot/boot/DFU action has its own reviewed input set and separately explicit operation scope; none is implied here.
Hand off verified subsets and known limitations to bench planning; active identity/noOutput tests retain their own prerequisites.
acceptance: Report ARCHIVE_VERIFIED, ENTRY_IDENTIFIED and RESTORE_REHEARSED separately.
A current whole-device recoverable claim requires cross-object consistency, live host/MCU mapping and observed recovery results; unknowns remain blockers to that claim.

Native identity sessions require audited request semantics, sufficient exclusive ownership and an exit plan; a completed whole-host restore is not an automatic prerequisite for every nonwriting request.
stop_conditions: Only irreplaceable original available with no failure containment, mismatch of target/range, missing unique-state preservation, or inability to meet the operation-specific exit plan.

dependency_rules: R2 host capture has no dependency on R3 recovery transport, R4 board exclusivity or R5 restore rehearsal.
R3 can proceed in parallel with R2; incomplete current contents keep the final recipe partial.
Panda identity/provisioning gaps block whole-system recovery and production claims, not unrelated host backup.
State-changing actions require action-specific backups and credible exits, not an impossible prior proof of the exact same destructive restore.

ready_local: Capture schema and local capacity planning
planned_capture_not_executed: Explicitly bounded current host images/application files after object list, budget and private destination are concrete
requires_separately_explicit_scope: Reading/copying private configuration or unique-state contents
Stopping/restarting services or altering supervisor behavior
Connecting extra Panda or changing physical power/USB roles
Opening/claiming USB/SPI or sending audited native requests
bounded_passive_under_current_authorized: Whitelisted file metadata and package versions without app import
Nonprivate service/supervisor topology and FD snapshots

local_validation.validation_scope: Local JSON/source-hash/range/dependency checks only; no target code imported or executed.
